# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 105 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 105 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_105_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 22

**1** "Now tell me," I said, "why is the tower built on water, Lord?" "I told you before," he said, "and you are still asking. So you inquire carefully into this." "Lord," I said, "because I cannot remember this; for it is great and marvelous, and I need to hear it." **2** "Listen then," he said; "why the tower is built on water — and you will understand. **3** Your life was saved and shall be saved through water. But the tower was founded on the word of the Almighty and glorious Name, and it is held firm by the unseen power of the Lord." **4** I answered and said to him, "Lord, this is great and wonderful. But, Lord, the name of the Lord is glorious; how is the tower founded upon the glorious name? **5** He said to me, "Because the name of the Lord is great and without limit and it upholds the whole creation. **6** If then all creation is upheld by the name of the Lord, how much more is the tower upheld by the name of the Lord, which is its foundation?" **7** "But who are the six glorious men around the tower with the young men?" **8** "These are six holy angels of God, who are the first created, and to whom the Lord delivered the whole of his creation to govern and build up; and by these six the tower is governed and completed. **9** But the others also helped them in building. And I asked him about the others who had helped in the building, and he said, 'These are angels of second rank.' But the first are the first created angels of God." **10** And I answered and said to him, "Lord, I want to know whether the tower is now complete." And he answered me, "It will be complete when the Lord has sent his final commission and the servants of God shall have been found worthy of life."

---

*EMET: the tower's foundation on water = on the word of God carried through baptism. The Name = the word of God that upholds creation. The "final commission" signals the parousia.*
